verses.original: כָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיִּקָּבְצ֧וּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָה לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ עַצְמְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ’el- dā·wîḏ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh lê·mōr hin·nêh ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū ū·ḇə·śā·rə·ḵā ‘aṣ·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said Here we [are] your own flesh and blood

verses.original: גַּם־ תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם־ שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם שָׁא֣וּל בִּהְי֣וֹת מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַמֵּבִ֖יא אֶת־ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- tə·mō·wl gam- šil·šō·wm gam šā·’ūl bih·yō·wṯ me·leḵ ’at·tāh ham·mō·w·ṣî yiś·rā·’êl wə·ham·mê·ḇî ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā way·yō·mer lə·ḵā ’at·tāh ṯir·‘eh ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh nā·ḡîḏ ‘al ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Even . . . . . . in times past . . . while Saul was king you [were] the one who led Israel out and brought them back - And the LORD your God said - You will shepherd - My people - Israel and you will be ruler over [them] . . .

verses.original: כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן דָּוִ֥יד וַיִּכְרֹת֩ בְּרִ֛ית לָהֶ֨ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn dā·wîḏ way·yiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ lā·hem lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yim·šə·ḥū ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- šə·mū·’êl
verses.literal: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron [where] David made a covenant with them before the LORD And they anointed - [him] king over Israel according to the word of the LORD through Samuel

verses.original: דָּוִ֧יד וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס וְשָׁם֙ הַיְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·leḵ yə·rū·šā·lim hî yə·ḇūs wə·šām hay·ḇū·sî yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is Jebus) where the Jebusites inhabited the land

verses.original: יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ לְדָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: yō·šə·ḇê yə·ḇūs way·yō·mə·rū lə·ḏā·wîḏ lō ṯā·ḇō·w hên·nāh dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- way·yil·kōḏ mə·ṣu·ḏaṯ ṣî·yō·wn hî ‘îr dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: The people of Jebus said to David You will never get in here Nevertheless , David - captured the fortress of Zion that is the City of David

verses.original: דָּוִ֔יד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּל־ בָּרִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ יִהְיֶ֥ה וּלְשָׂ֑ר לְרֹ֖אשׁ יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה וַיַּ֧עַל בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה וַיְהִ֥י לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yō·mer kāl- bā·ri·šō·w·nāh mak·kêh yə·ḇū·sî yih·yeh ū·lə·śār lə·rōš yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh way·ya·‘al bā·ri·šō·w·nāh way·hî lə·rōš
verses.literal: Now David had said Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first and he became the chief

verses.original: דָּוִ֖יד וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בַּמְצָ֑ד עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ־ ל֖וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yê·šeḇ bam·ṣāḏ ‘al- kên qā·rə·’ū- lōw ‘îr dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: So David took up residence in the fortress that is why . . . it was called the City of David

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן הָעִיר֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב מִן־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וְעַד־ הַסָּבִ֑יב וְיוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת־ שְׁאָ֥ר הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen hā·‘îr mis·sā·ḇîḇ min- ham·mil·lō·w wə·‘aḏ- has·sā·ḇîḇ wə·yō·w·’āḇ yə·ḥay·yeh ’eṯ- šə·’ār hā·‘îr
verses.literal: He built up the city around it from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall while Joab restored - the rest of the city

verses.original: דָּוִ֖יד וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: And David became greater and greater for the LORD of Hosts was with him

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י לְדָוִ֔יד הַגִּבּוֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֧וֹ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִיכ֑וֹ הַמִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים בְמַלְכוּת֛וֹ עִם־ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh rā·šê lə·ḏā·wîḏ hag·gib·bō·w·rîm ’ă·šer ‘im·mōw kāl- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ham·lî·ḵōw ham·miṯ·ḥaz·zə·qîm ḇə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw ‘im- kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now these [were] the chiefs of David’s mighty men who together with all Israel bolstered and strengthened his kingdom according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר לְדָוִ֑יד הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשָׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁים הֽוּא־ עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֛וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל אֶחָֽת׃ בְּפַ֥עַם
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mis·par lə·ḏā·wîḏ hag·gib·bō·rîm ’ă·šer yā·šā·ḇə·‘ām ben- ḥaḵ·mō·w·nî rōš haš·šə·lō·šīm hū- ‘ō·w·rêr ’eṯ- ḥă·nî·ṯōw ‘al- šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·lāl ’e·ḥāṯ bə·p̄a·‘am
verses.literal: This is the list of David’s mighty men - Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers he wielded - his spear against three hundred men whom he killed at one time

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ הָאֲחוֹחִ֑י ה֖וּא בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rāw ’el·‘ā·zār ben- dō·w·ḏōw hā·’ă·ḥō·w·ḥî hū biš·lō·wō·šāh hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite . . . one of the three mighty men

verses.original: הֽוּא־ הָיָ֨ה עִם־ דָּוִ֜יד בַּפַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים וְהַפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֱסְפוּ־ שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hū- hā·yāh ‘im- dā·wîḏ bap·pas dam·mîm wə·hap·pə·liš·tîm ne·’ĕs·p̄ū- šå̄m lam·mil·ḥā·māh wat·tə·hî ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh mə·lê·’āh śə·‘ō·w·rîm wə·hā·‘ām nā·sū mip·pə·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: He was with David vvv at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle At a place with a field full of barley the troops fled from the Philistines

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְתוֹךְ־ הַחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּיל֔וּהָ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים יְהוָ֖ה וַיּ֥וֹשַׁע גְדוֹלָֽה׃ תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū ḇə·ṯō·wḵ- ha·ḥel·qāh way·yaṣ·ṣî·lū·hā way·yak·kū ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm Yah·weh way·yō·wō·ša‘ ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh tə·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it They struck down - the Philistines and the LORD brought about a great victory

verses.original: שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ וַיֵּרְד֡וּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔יד עַל־ הַצֻּר֙ אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·wō·šāh min- haš·šə·lō·wō·šîm rōš way·yê·rə·ḏū ’el- dā·wîḏ ‘al- haṣ·ṣur ’el- mə·‘ā·raṯ ‘ă·ḏul·lām ū·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm ḥō·nāh bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim

verses.original: אָ֣ז וְדָוִ֖יד בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּנְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz wə·ḏā·wîḏ bam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh ū·nə·ṣîḇ pə·liš·tîm ’āz bə·ḇêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: At that time David was in the stronghold and the garrison of the Philistines . . . vvv was at Bethlehem

verses.original: דָּוִ֖יד וַיִּתְאָו וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבּ֥וֹר בֵּֽית־ בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃ לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yiṯ·ʾå̄w way·yō·mar mî yaš·qê·nî ma·yim mib·bō·wr bêṯ- baš·šā·‘ar le·ḥem ’ă·šer
verses.literal: David longed for water and said Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem -

verses.original: הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֜ה וַיִּבְקְע֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֙יִם֙ מִבּ֤וֹר בֵּֽית־ בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֑יד דָוִיד֙ וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֤ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיְנַסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·lō·šāh way·yiḇ·qə·‘ū p̄ə·liš·tîm bə·ma·ḥă·nêh way·yiš·’ă·ḇū- ma·yim mib·bō·wr bêṯ- baš·ša·‘ar way·yiś·’ū le·ḥem ’ă·šer way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’el- dā·wîḏ ḏā·wîḏ wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh liš·tō·w·ṯām way·nas·sêḵ ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp drew water from the well at the gate . . . of Bethlehem - and brought it back to David But he refused . . . to drink it instead , he poured it out - to the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָה֩ לִּ֨י מֵאֱלֹהַ֜י מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת זֹ֗את אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה הֲדַ֣ם הָאֵ֨לֶּה הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ בְנַפְשׁוֹתָם֙ כִּ֣י הֱבִיא֔וּם בְנַפְשׁוֹתָ֣ם אָבָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥā·lî·lāh lî mê·’ĕ·lō·hay mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ zōṯ ’eš·teh hă·ḏam hā·’êl·leh hā·’ă·nā·šîm ḇə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯām kî hĕ·ḇî·’ūm ḇə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḇāh wə·lō liš·tō·w·ṯām ’êl·leh ‘ā·śū šə·lō·šeṯ hag·gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: saying Far be it from me my God to do this How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives [David] refused . . . to drink it Such were the exploits of the three mighty men

verses.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י אֲחִֽי־ יוֹאָ֗ב הָיָה֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה וְהוּא֙ ה֤וּא עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְלֹא שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלוֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·šay ’ă·ḥî- yō·w·’āḇ hā·yāh rōš haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh wə·hū hū ‘ō·w·rêr ’eṯ- ḥă·nî·ṯōw ‘al- šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·lāl wə·lō šêm baš·šə·lō·wō·šāh
verses.literal: Now Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three . . . and he wielded - his spear against three hundred [men] killed [them] and won a name along with [the] Three

verses.original: בַשְּׁנַ֙יִם֙ נִכְבָּ֔ד מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־ לֹֽא־ בָֽא׃ס הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ḇaš·šə·na·yim niḵ·bāḏ min- haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh way·hî lā·hem lə·śār wə·‘aḏ- lō- ḇā haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh
verses.literal: He was doubly honored above the Three and he became their commander . . . even though he was not included among the Three

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֨ה בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־ אִֽישׁ־ חַ֛יִל מִֽן־ קַבְצְאֵ֑ל רַב־ פְּעָלִ֖ים ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִיאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃ בְּי֥וֹם וְ֠הוּא יָרַ֞ד בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבּ֖וֹר וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־ הָאֲרִ֛י
verses.transliteration: bə·nā·yāh ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- ’îš- ḥa·yil min- qaḇ·ṣə·’êl raḇ- pə·‘ā·lîm hū hik·kāh ’êṯ šə·nê ’ă·rî·’êl mō·w·’āḇ haš·šā·leḡ bə·yō·wm wə·hū yā·raḏ bə·ṯō·wḵ hab·bō·wr wə·hik·kāh ’eṯ- hā·’ă·rî
verses.literal: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada vvv was a man of valor from Kabzeel a man of many exploits [He] struck down - two champions of Moab and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed - a lion

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־ הִכָּה֩ אֶת־ הָאִ֨ישׁ הַמִּצְרִ֜י אִ֥ישׁ מִדָּ֣ה׀ חָמֵ֣שׁ בָּאַמָּ֗ה הַמִּצְרִ֤י חֲנִית֙ אֹרְגִ֔ים כִּמְנ֣וֹר וּבְיַ֨ד וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ הַמִּצְרִ֔י מִיַּ֣ד וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hik·kāh ’eṯ- hā·’îš ham·miṣ·rî ’îš mid·dāh ḥā·mêš bā·’am·māh ham·miṣ·rî ḥă·nîṯ ’ō·rə·ḡîm kim·nō·wr ū·ḇə·yaḏ way·yê·reḏ ’ê·lāw baš·šā·ḇeṭ way·yiḡ·zōl ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·nîṯ ham·miṣ·rî mî·yaḏ way·ya·har·ḡê·hū ba·ḥă·nî·ṯōw
verses.literal: He also struck down - - an Egyptian a huge man five cubits [tall] Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand Benaiah went against him with a club snatched - the spear from [his] hand and killed [the Egyptian] with his own spear

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ‘ā·śāh bə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·lōw- šêm biš·lō·wō·šāh hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada who won a name along with the three mighty men

verses.original: נִכְבָּד֙ מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֗ים הִנּ֤וֹ ה֔וּא לֹא־ בָ֑א וְאֶל־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה דָוִ֖יד וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ עַל־ מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: niḵ·bāḏ min- haš·šə·lō·wō·šîm hin·nōw hū lō- ḇā wə·’el- haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh ḏā·wîḏ way·śî·mê·hū ‘al- miš·ma‘·tōw
verses.literal: He was most honored among the Thirty . . . but he did not become one of the Three And David appointed him over his guard

verses.original: וְגִבּוֹרֵ֖י הַחֲיָלִ֑ים עֲשָׂה־ אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡib·bō·w·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm ‘ă·śāh- ’êl ’ă·ḥî yō·w·’āḇ ’el·ḥā·nān ben- dō·w·ḏōw mib·bêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Now [these were] the mighty men . . . vvv Asahel the brother of Joab Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem

verses.original: שַׁמּוֹת֙ הַהֲרוֹרִ֔י חֶ֖לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: šam·mō·wṯ ha·hă·rō·w·rî ḥe·leṣ hap·pə·lō·w·nî
verses.literal: Shammoth the Harorite Helez the Pelonite

verses.original: עִירָ֤א בֶן־ עִקֵּשׁ֙ הַתְּקוֹעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר הָעֲנְּתוֹתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘î·rā ḇen- ‘iq·qêš hat·tə·qō·w·‘î ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer hā·‘ăn·nə·ṯō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite Abiezer the Anathothite

verses.original: סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י עִילַ֖י הָאֲחוֹחִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: sib·bə·ḵay ha·ḥu·šā·ṯî ‘î·lay hā·’ă·ḥō·w·ḥî
verses.literal: Sibbecai the Hushathite Ilai the Ahohite

verses.original: מַהְרַי֙ הַנְּטֹ֣פָתִ֔י חֵ֥לֶד בֶּֽן־ בַּֽעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטוֹפָתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: mah·ray han·nə·ṭō·p̄ā·ṯî ḥê·leḏ ben- ba·‘ă·nāh han·nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Maharai the Netophathite Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite

verses.original: אִיתַ֣י בֶּן־ רִיבַ֗י מִגִּבְעַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ןס בְּנָיָ֖ה הַפִּרְעָתֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·ṯay ben- rî·ḇay mig·giḇ·‘aṯ bə·nê ḇin·yå̄·mi·ns bə·nā·yāh hap·pir·‘ā·ṯō·nî
verses.literal: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites . . . Benaiah the Pirathonite

verses.original: חוּרַי֙ מִנַּ֣חֲלֵי גָ֔עַשׁס אֲבִיאֵ֖ל הָעַרְבָתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥū·ray min·na·ḥă·lê ḡå̄·ʿa·šs ’ă·ḇî·’êl hā·‘ar·ḇā·ṯî
verses.literal: Hurai from the brooks of Gaash Abiel the Arbathite

verses.original: עַזְמָ֙וֶת֙ הַבַּ֣חֲרוּמִ֔י אֶלְיַחְבָּ֖א הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘az·mā·weṯ hab·ba·ḥă·rū·mî ’el·yaḥ·bā haš·ša·‘al·ḇō·nî
verses.literal: Azmaveth the Baharumite Eliahba the Shaalbonite

verses.original: בְּנֵ֗י הָשֵׁם֙ הַגִּ֣זוֹנִ֔י יוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־ שָׁגֵ֖ה הַהֲרָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê hā·šêm hag·gi·zō·w·nî yō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·ḡêh ha·hă·rā·rî
verses.literal: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite

verses.original: אֲחִיאָ֧ם בֶּן־ שָׂכָ֛ר הַהֲרָרִ֖י אֱלִיפַ֥ל בֶּן־ אֽוּר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḥî·’ām ben- śā·ḵār ha·hă·rā·rî ’ĕ·lî·p̄al ben- ’ūr
verses.literal: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite Eliphal son of Ur

verses.original: חֵ֚פֶר הַמְּכֵ֣רָתִ֔י אֲחִיָּ֖ה הַפְּלֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥê·p̄er ham·mə·ḵê·rā·ṯî ’ă·ḥî·yāh hap·pə·lō·nî
verses.literal: Hepher the Mecherathite Ahijah the Pelonite

verses.original: חֶצְרוֹ֙ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י נַעֲרַ֖י בֶּן־ אֶזְבָּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥeṣ·rōw hak·kar·mə·lî na·‘ă·ray ben- ’ez·bāy
verses.literal: Hezro the Carmelite Naarai son of Ezbai

verses.original: יוֹאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י נָתָ֔ן מִבְחָ֖ר בֶּן־ הַגְרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’êl ’ă·ḥî nā·ṯān miḇ·ḥār ben- haḡ·rî
verses.literal: Joel the brother of Nathan Mibhar son of Hagri

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמּוֹנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַבֵּ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣe·leq hā·‘am·mō·w·nî naḥ·ray hab·bê·rō·ṯî nō·śê kə·lê yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh
verses.literal: Zelek the Ammonite Naharai the Beerothite the armor-bearer . . . of Joab son of Zeruiah

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘î·rā hay·yiṯ·rî gā·rêḇ hay·yiṯ·rî
verses.literal: Ira the Ithrite Gareb the Ithrite

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַחִתִּ֔י זָבָ֖ד בֶּן־ אַחְלָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ū·rî·yāh ha·ḥit·tî zā·ḇāḏ ben- ’aḥ·lāy
verses.literal: Uriah the Hittite Zabad son of Ahlai

verses.original: עֲדִינָ֨א בֶן־ שִׁיזָ֜א הָרֽאוּבֵנִ֗י רֹ֛אשׁ לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י שְׁלוֹשִֽׁים׃ס וְעָלָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḏî·nā ḇen- šî·zā hā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî rōš lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî šə·lō·wō·šîm wə·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite chief of the Reubenites and the thirty with him

verses.original: חָנָן֙ בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְיוֹשָׁפָ֖ט הַמִּתְנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·nān ben- ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·yō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ham·miṯ·nî
verses.literal: Hanan son of Maacah Joshaphat the Mithnite

verses.original: עֻזִיָּ֖א הָעֲשְׁתְּרָתִ֑י שָׁמָע֙ וִיעוּאֵל בְּנֵ֖י חוֹתָ֥ם הָעֲרֹעֵרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘u·zî·yā hā·‘ăš·tə·rā·ṯî šā·mā‘ wī·ʿū·ʾēl bə·nê ḥō·w·ṯām hā·‘ă·rō·‘ê·rî
verses.literal: Uzzia the Ashterathite Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite

verses.original: יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ בֶּן־ שִׁמְרִ֔י אָחִ֖יו וְיֹחָ֥א הַתִּיצִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏî·‘ă·’êl ben- šim·rî ’ā·ḥîw wə·yō·ḥā hat·tî·ṣî
verses.literal: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵל֙ הַֽמַּחֲוִ֔ים וִירִיבַ֥י וְיוֹשַׁוְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְנָ֑עַם וְיִתְמָ֖ה הַמּוֹאָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·’êl ham·ma·ḥă·wîm wî·rî·ḇay wə·yō·wō·šaw·yāh bə·nê ’el·nā·‘am wə·yiṯ·māh ham·mō·w·’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: Eliel the Mahavite Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam Ithmah the Moabite

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְעוֹבֵ֔ד וְיַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל הַמְּצֹבָיָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·’êl wə·‘ō·w·ḇêḏ wə·ya·‘ă·śî·’êl ham·mə·ṣō·ḇā·yāh
verses.literal: Eliel Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite
